purpose: Machine-readable record of Plan capabilities this skill cannot deliver as advertised, so an agent stops instead of substituting another endpoint, a token exchange or UI automation.

policy.reportAs: unavailable, with the missing input or route named
policy.note: Capabilities are described in words. Route shapes are deliberately absent so nothing here can be copied into a request.

capabilities.request: Publish role-specific Home cards, priorities or layout order.
capabilities.reason: No public Plan definition route; the older package reached this through a workload access route.
capabilities.publicPart: Public Home visibility is set in the create request; card content can be prepared locally but not published.

capabilities.request: Create or register a Planning column through the native column service.
capabilities.reason: Native column service is a workload surface; use the public definition parts in plan.py build and planning-column-presentation.
capabilities.publicPart: runtime.planning_presentation and the Planning column presentation command.

capabilities.request: Read, write or bind report bookmarks.
capabilities.reason: Bookmark state is held outside the public Plan definition.
capabilities.publicPart: Page Navigator destinations expressed as definition parts.

capabilities.request: Execute or poll an InfoBridge query and stream its result.
capabilities.reason: Execution is an engine workload route. Queries are authored, not run, by this skill.

capabilities.request: Place or restyle a visual through the native page API.
capabilities.reason: Native page writes require the proxy this skill does not use.
capabilities.publicPart: construct-native and audit-layout for placement expressed in the definition.

capabilities.request: Activate a Pivot feature flag on a saved item.
capabilities.reason: Activation was a workload properties batch write.
capabilities.publicPart: runtime.pivots shapes the definition part only.

capabilities.request: Read a PowerTable source schema back from the native schema service.
capabilities.reason: Schema readback is a workload route; approver-user assignment and file, template and semantic workload routes have no public path.

capabilities.request: Create a Navigator through the rules engine service.
capabilities.reason: Rules engine and its variable stores are workload services.
capabilities.publicPart: construct-native assembles Navigator parts inside the Plan definition.

capabilities.request: Negotiate SQL versus OneLake metadata backends or recover a failed metadata collection.
capabilities.reason: The older package performed these reads through an artifact-scoped proxy obtained by a workload token exchange, which this skill blocks.
capabilities.publicPart: Nothing. Report the capability as unavailable.

capabilities.request: Read saved Arial defaults back from a native expansion.
capabilities.reason: No registered command; typography is authored into the definition.
capabilities.publicPart: runtime.application_typography during build; see the native typography guide.

capabilities.request: Run the forecast review update phase as one command.
capabilities.reason: scripts/runtime/forecast_review.py ships as a library used by the recipe helpers; no standalone forecast-review command is registered.
capabilities.publicPart: runtime.forecast_review functions; forecast-repair for a scoped ALM update.

capabilities.request: Audit storage context through a dedicated command.
capabilities.reason: scripts/runtime/storage_context.py is applied by build, construct-native and the usecase recipe checks; no standalone audit subcommand is registered.
capabilities.publicPart: runtime.storage_context signature, require_same, query_contract, require_query, audit_links.

capabilities.request: Read the physical column metadata of a Fabric SQL database for PowerTable maintenance.
capabilities.reason: The public SQL database definition read ships as runtime.sql_definition.read_sql_project; no registered command in this package invokes it.
capabilities.publicPart: powertable-table consumes the physical metadata you supply; runtime.sql_definition.physical_table and catalog_table parse it.

capabilities.request: Apply IBCS recipe styling beyond the chart theme and its colors: data labels, title and number settings, top-N ranking, deviation callouts or explicit group colors.
capabilities.reason: Picking a theme in the product also recomputes settings outside the chart appearance, and in-product AI chart state is applied by the running chart rather than read from a saved definition. Several recipe settings have no saved-definition route in the current product.
capabilities.publicPart: runtime.ibcs_charts.recipe_chart writes the recipe chart template, bucket bindings and the IBCS chart theme with its measure and variance colors; runtime.ibcs_charts.apply_chart_theme does the same for an exported chart; runtime.ibcs_report.set_plan_theme sets the Plan-wide theme type in the plan properties part on explicit request.
